subject.title: fix(signal): add timeouts to container REST requests

question: Should the existing Signal container `timeoutMs` intentionally bound response-body transfer as part of the complete REST operation?
rationale: The patch fixes an indefinite hang but deliberately changes timeout behavior for slow valid bodies, which requires owner acceptance rather than contributor repair.

options.title: Accept complete-operation deadline
options.body: Merge with the existing timeout covering connection, headers, and bounded response-body consumption.

options.title: Define separate body timing
options.body: Pause and introduce a distinct body-transfer deadline only if valid slow responses must outlive the existing request timeout.

recommendation.title: Accept complete-operation deadline
recommendation.body: Merge with the existing timeout covering connection, headers, and bounded response-body consumption.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent history includes the existing timer-cap behavior and integration of the current Signal client, making them the clearest available owner for the compatibility choice.
